answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 6 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the harbor release is written down with every signature, the echo audit publishes the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the anchor graph and each risks its bond. That is 13 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
